public.text: The Computable Decision Support Engine is presented as one shared component. Clinical decision support may be distributed among knowledge repositories, rules services, application-integrated logic, and point-of-care workflow integration.
public.suggestedRevision: Separate governed computable knowledge from execution services and workflow integration, or explain that the CDSE is a logical capability that may be realised through several distributed components.
